messages:
nikki: publish failed for build 2026-03-22_03:12 -> missing blob referenced by manifest (sha256:aa11...bb22). deploy-bot aborted the job.

deploy-bot: publish blocked: 412 Manifest validation failed - missing blob sha256:aa11bb22 in ecr://redwood-staging/us-east-1. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/7788#publish

marta: do we know if the builder uploaded the blob correctly or if the mirror couldn't fetch it?

nikki: CI shows upload succeeded to builder bucket but HEAD from origin returned 404 during mirror fetch (`NoSuchKey`). Suspect lifecycle GC or cross-region replication lag.

eng-infra: I'll check GC logs for prefix `staging/2026-03-22/` and open a hold if needed. If object already deleted we'll need a repush.

sam: short-term: pin `staging` to previous digest so canary stays stable. Then republish in the 04:00 UTC change window under a new path.

deploy-bot: action queued: `canary-hold staging` requested by sam. Reply `approve` to lock.

marta: approve. Also add temp tag plan: retag previous digest to `staging-temp-1765000000` for testing while we republish.

eng-infra: INFRA-5233 created to hold lifecycle for staging prefix; if trace shows deletion already occurred we'll coordinate rebuild. Also investigating mirror-worker 4xx spikes.

security-bot: incident INC-2026-0450 opened for publish failure; security to re-run attestation after republish.

sam: republish checklist: (1) rebuild/upload under `staging/2026-03-22/republish-1765000000/` (2) publish with `--re-sign --no-cache` (3) wait for security ack (~10m) (4) verify canary (5) rotate staging tag and revoke `staging-temp`.

nikki: posting release notes blurb now. I'll run the republish during the 04:00 window and update when it starts.
